templates.title: ZimaBrain CE
templates.name: zimabrain
templates.description: ZimaBrain CE is a local verifier-first diagnostic assistant for ZimaOS. It checks host evidence and keeps monitor history in a local SQLite database.

env.name: ZIMABRAIN_PASSWORD
env.label: ZIMABRAIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Login password for the ZimaBrain web UI. The container exits while this is empty or still the catalog value. Replace it in the install form before the first start.

env.name: ZIMABRAIN_SECRET_KEY
env.label: ZIMABRAIN_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Internal session key. Not the login password.

env.name: ZIMABRAIN_MONITOR_ENABLED
env.label: ZIMABRAIN_MONITOR_ENABLED
env.description: Collect local CPU, memory, disk, and container samples.

env.name: ZIMABRAIN_MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS
env.label: ZIMABRAIN_MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Days of monitor history to keep.
